attacks.name: Mech Abomination - Echo Skill
expressions:
Strike enemies in front, dealing 30.40% Electro DMG, and summon Mech Waste to attack. Mech Waste deals 200.00% Electro DMG on hit and explodes after a while, dealing 100.00% Electro DMG.
After casting this Echo Skill, increase the current character's ATK by 12.00% for 15s.
Damage dealt by Mech Waste equals to the Resonator's Outro Skill DMG.
CD: 20s
